tools.name: get_security_scan_quote
tools.description: Returns the repository's full-scan estimate, its freshness and the organization's available Deep Scan credit in cents. Compare available_credit_cents with estimated_amount_cents to see whether credits cover this estimate. A null balance is unknown. Stored estimates are reused even when stale. Scan admission rechecks funding at start.

tools.name: start_security_scans
tools.description: Request a full or delta Deep Scan.
